IMPLEMENTED SCOPE
Project receipt sheet reads local saved/transferring/retry records, timestamps,
sizes, concise errors and local thumbnails. All/Pending/Saved filters include
automatic-effect pending/retry state. Opening it does not connect or download.
Explicit retry and continue-project actions retain the selected existing project;
local effect retry does not require a camera. No project is automatically created.
Photo stars persist; Project and Downloaded offer a star filter. Download identity
binding retains camera-photo stars on local originals across Activity recreation.
Default presets can be selected for new or existing projects from validated local
presets. New originals are retained, then automatic local processing creates and
publishes effect copies using the existing NCP phone approximation. Configuration
changes/disablement affect later discoveries only; queued tasks retain the fixed
preset. Originals have reception priority; automatic work waits for manual batches.
Queued/processing tasks recover after process restart; failed work requires explicit
retry. Owned source basename/byte length and existing derived-output/publication
idempotency checks protect source files and avoid duplicate effect publication.
This does not add camera-native rendering or change preset-import authorization.
